questions.prompt: Where should a BlazeMeter API key used by GitHub Actions live?
questions.explanation: Secrets are encrypted and masked in logs. Files in the repo are readable by anyone with access and stay in history.

questions.prompt: bzt exit code 1 means the performance criteria failed.
questions.explanation: 1 is a generic error (network, internal). Pass/fail criteria shutdown is 3.

questions.prompt: Which product answers 'is my API up and returning correct data every few minutes?'
questions.explanation: API Monitoring runs scheduled functional API checks with alerts; load tests measure behaviour under many users.

questions.prompt: Which Taurus command starts a cloud test and exits without waiting for results?
questions.explanation: -detach launches the cloud test and exits; -report streams a local run; -locations lists available locations.

questions.prompt: Which practices keep the key safe in CI? Select all that apply.
options: A dedicated, revocable key for CI
Do not expose secrets to fork pull requests
echo the token to debug auth
Rotate the key if it leaks
questions.explanation: Dedicated keys, no fork exposure and rotation limit damage. Echoing defeats the purpose of secrets.

questions.prompt: A step runs `bzt smoke.yml || true`. Criteria fail with exit 3. What is the job result?
questions.explanation: `|| true` swallows the non-zero exit, so the gate is disabled. Remove it.

questions.prompt: Your PR smoke test fails randomly 1 in 5 runs on p90 on shared runners, with no code changes. What is the best fix?
options: Keep the PR gate loose (catch large regressions, use errors and generous percentile limits over a steady window) and move tight percentile gates to dedicated nightly cloud runs with baselines
questions.explanation: Shared runners are noisy. Tight absolute gates belong on controlled infrastructure; retries hide real issues.

questions.prompt: Your nightly BlazeMeter job must fail when performance degrades more than 10% versus last good run, without editing numbers each time. What do you configure?
options: A baseline on the BlazeMeter test and criteria like avg-rt>baseline+10% (for an existing test with a baseline)
questions.explanation: Baseline-based criteria compare to a reference run automatically. They require an existing BlazeMeter test with a baseline when run from Taurus.

coding.title: Map bzt exit codes to CI outcomes
coding.prompt: Write `ci_outcome(exit_code)` returning `'pass'` for 0, `'performance-fail'` for 3, `'cancelled'` for 2 and `'error'` for anything else (including 1 and unknown codes).
coding.explanation: Distinguishing a performance failure (3) from an infrastructure error (1) tells the team whether to investigate the code or the pipeline.

coding.title: Redact secrets from a log
coding.prompt:
Before uploading logs as artifacts, write `redact_tokens(log_text, secrets)` that replaces every occurrence of each non-empty secret with `***`. Replace **longer secrets first** so a secret containing another one is fully masked.

Example: `redact_tokens('token=abc:xyz', ['abc:xyz'])` returns `'token=***'`.
coding.explanation: Sorting by length avoids leaving fragments: masking 'abc' before 'abc:xyz' would produce '***:xyz', leaking part of the secret. Empty strings are skipped because replacing '' would corrupt the text.
